import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;

    static long gcd(long a, long b) {
        return b != 0 ? gcd(b, a % b) : a;
    }

    static long lcm(long a, long b) {
        return a / gcd(a, b) * b;
    }

    static long modpow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        base %= mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % mod;
            }
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static int modadd(int a, int b, int mod) {
        a += b;
        if (a >= mod) a -= mod;
        return a;
    }

    static int modsub(int a, int b, int mod) {
        a -= b;
        if (a < 0) a += mod;
        return a;
    }

    static int modmul(int a, int b, int mod) {
        return (int) ((long) a * b % mod);
    }

    static int modinv(int a, int mod) {
        return (int) modpow(a, mod - 2, mod);
    }

    static void fwht(int[] a, int n, boolean invert) {
        for (int len = 1; len < n; len <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len << 1) {
                for (int j = 0; j < len; ++j) {
                    int x = a[i + j], y = a[i + j + len];
                    if (!invert) {
                        a[i + j] = modadd(x, y, MOD);
                        a[i + j + len] = x;
                    } else {
                        a[i + j] = modadd(x, modsub(y, 0, MOD), MOD);
                        a[i + j + len] = y;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int[] subsetConvolution(int[] a, int k, int mod) {
        int n = a.length;
        int N = 1;
        while (N < n) N <<= 1;
        int[] aPadded = Arrays.copyOf(a, N);
        
        final int LOG = 19;
        int[][] f = new int[LOG][N];
        
        for (int i = 0; i < LOG; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(j) == i) {
                    f[i][j] = (j < aPadded.length) ? aPadded[j] : 0;
                }
            }
            fwht(f[i], N, false);
        }
        
        int[][] g = new int[LOG][N];
        
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            int[] vals = new int[LOG];
            for (int j = 0; j < LOG; ++j) {
                vals[j] = f[j][i];
            }
            
            int[] res = new int[LOG];
            res[0] = 1;
            for (int _ = 0; _ < k; ++_) {
                int[] tmp = new int[LOG];
                for (int j = 0; j < LOG; ++j) {
                    for (int l = 0; l + j < LOG; ++l) {
                        tmp[j + l] = modadd(tmp[j + l], modmul(res[j], vals[l], mod), mod);
                    }
                }
                res = tmp;
            }
            
            for (int j = 0; j < LOG; ++j) {
                g[j][i] = res[j];
            }
        }
        
        int[] result = new int[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < LOG; ++i) {
            int[] temp = Arrays.copyOf(g[i], N);
            fwht(temp, N, true);
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (Integer.bitCount(j) == i) {
                    result[j] = temp[j];
                }
            }
        }
        
        return Arrays.copyOf(result, n);
    }

    static final int MAXN = 1000005;
    static int n, k, p;
    static int[] fact = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] invfact = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] f_arr = new int[MAXN];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        p = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        int nn = n;
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
            if ((n & i) == i) {
                int t = 0;
                for (int j = 0; j < 20; ++j) {
                    if ((n & (1 << j)) != 0) {
                        t <<= 1;
                        t |= ((i >> j) & 1);
                    }
                }
                f_arr[t] = i;
                nn = t;
            }
        }
        
        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(modpow(k, n, p));
            return;
        }
        
        fact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; ++i) {
            fact[i] = modmul(fact[i-1], i, p);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; ++i) {
            invfact[i] = modinv(fact[i], p);
        }
        
        int[] a = new int[nn + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= nn; ++i) {
            a[i] = invfact[f_arr[i]];
        }
        
        int res = (int) modpow(k, n, p);
        a = subsetConvolution(a, k, p);
        res = modsub(res, modmul(a[nn], fact[n], p), p);
        System.out.println(res);
    }
}
